item.text:
Extracted the remaining `TermuxService` session and notification responsibilities into a dedicated manager.

What changed:
- Added [`TermuxServiceSessionManager`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxServiceSessionManager.java#L1), which now owns:
  - start-command dispatch
  - execution-command parsing
  - wake lock handling
  - session/task creation and cleanup
  - notification building and updates
  - session client wiring and query helpers
- Replaced [`TermuxService`](file:///Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/TermuxService.java#L1) with a thin Android wrapper that delegates lifecycle and API calls to the manager.

Result:
- `TermuxService` is now mostly lifecycle plumbing and public delegation.
- The session/notification logic has a single owner, which makes future changes safer and easier to reason about.

Verification:
- I did a static sanity pass on the rewritten files.
- I could not run a Gradle build here because this workspace still lacks `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`.

If you want, I can keep going and apply the same pattern to the remaining large `TermuxActivity` behavior helpers next.
